study: Herman et al. 2022 — CHAMPS classroom-management TPD, cluster RCT, middle school achievement
delivery_evidence: CHAMPS 'delivered as large group training workshops followed by in-person coaching and feedback'; teachers attended two/three full-day group trainings plus an on-site doctoral-level coach with classroom observations (Method, CHAMPS section, MS p.~7-8).
test_alignment_evidence: Achievement outcomes are the Missouri Assessment Program (MAP) state standardized test and the Stanford Achievement Test 10th ed. (SAT-10), both broad standardized batteries unrelated to CHAMPS content (Tables 6-7, MS p.11).
curriculum_evidence: CHAMPS is a fully developed program teachers adopt, with a series of training/coaching materials plus 'Books, planning materials, and DVD's to support implementation' provided (CHAMPS section, MS p.~7); a management-program/materials package, though not an academic content curriculum.
outcome_timing_evidence: Achievement measured spring of the single intervention school year (end of year 1: spring MAP; April/May SAT-10); no delayed post-treatment wave (Tables 6-7; extraction timepoint=post).
